curation.notes: AFM-SMFS (Bruker Bioscope Resolve) in height-clamp mode: SARS-CoV-2 spike membrane-binding peptides (primed MBP1, unprimed MBP2, an MBP1 mutant, and a membrane-proximal peptide control) or the spike S2 subunit grafted onto AC40 tips via APTES/NHS-PEG24 and sortase A, held ~6 nm above DOPC/cholesterol or DOPC/sphingomyelin supported bilayers for 10 s to record force-time binding events; bond lifetimes fitted with Bell and Dudko-Hummer-Szabo models. Biolayer interferometry, MD simulations and pseudovirus infectivity assays complement the SMFS.
